key_points: New efficacy data from Foundayo and EloraTZP studies underscores progress in Lilly's obesity/diabetes pipeline.
EloraTZP surpassed Zepbound on efficacy but raised tolerability concerns, prompting short‑term stock pressure.
Late‑stage obesity and diabetes trial results were strong, reinforcing pipeline value.
Lilly's weight‑loss pill is linked to a 57% lower predicted 10‑year diabetes risk and 18% lower heart disease risk.
Trump highlighted Lilly’s $3.5B factory expansion and global weight‑loss pill plans; Medicare pricing model expected to affect only a few firms.
